name: podcast
description: Research any topic and turn it into a verified, podcast-style MP3 — parallel research agents, claims re-checked against primary sources, a script written for the ear, local text-to-speech, and a whisper round-trip that catches dropped or garbled audio. Pick a cast (two hosts, a solo narrator, or a three-voice panel that argues a question from both sides) and get a tagged, chaptered episode. Works with nothing installed (it writes the script); upgrade voices and QA when you want them.

episodes_dir.title: Episodes folder
episodes_dir.description: Where episodes are written (script, sources, audio).

voice_engine.title: Voice engine
voice_engine.description: auto (default) — use the best installed engine, and install kokoro (≈521 MB on disk, best quality) the first time an episode needs audio. none — script only, nothing downloads. piper — ≈375 MB, faster, noticeably thinner voices. kokoro — pin the best engine explicitly. Change later with: /podcast upgrade voice

default_cast.title: Default cast
default_cast.description: Who hosts an episode when the request doesn't say: two-host (a host and a co-host), panel (moderator, advocate and skeptic — used automatically for debates) or solo (one narrator). Any name in casts/ works. Change later with: /podcast --cast <name>

voice_blocklist.title: Voices to never use
voice_blocklist.description: Comma-separated voice ids to drop from every cast's rotation, e.g. af_nova,am_santa. Say “I don't like that voice” during an episode and it gets added here.

qa_level.title: Audio QA level
qa_level.description: auto (use what's installed), none (skip), base (≈575 MB including the transcription runtime), small or medium (larger, more accurate). Checks rendered audio against the script. Change later with: /podcast upgrade qa

telegram_bot.title: Telegram bot name (optional)
telegram_bot.description: Name of a bot in ~/.config/telegram-send/bots.json to deliver episodes to. Leave blank to just save the file locally.

listener_profile.title: Listener profile (optional)
listener_profile.description: Path to a markdown file describing who is listening, so episodes speak to you directly. Leave blank for a neutral audience.

auto_setup.title: Install missing pieces automatically
auto_setup.description: always (default) — when an episode needs ffmpeg, a voice or the audio checker and they are missing, install them in the background while the research runs, no sudo and nothing outside the plugin's folder. audio-only — skip the audio checker. never — install nothing unless asked.
